title: pCloud says it contained a cyberattack on its Pass password manager that exposed user email addresses
date_note: Clubic's page, published 27 November, gives no earlier day for pCloud's statement; users received the alerts overnight.
geo_basis: country: Clubic says pCloud is a Swiss company; no city stated, pin is country-level
summary: Clubic reports that pCloud Pass users received alerts of an unknown device login overnight, even with two-factor authentication on. According to Clubic, pCloud said on Reddit it quickly contained a cyberattack that exposed the email addresses of a limited number of users, and that passwords and vault data were not compromised. Clubic says pCloud had not answered its questions.
plain: Clubic reports that pCloud says an attack on its password manager exposed the email addresses of a limited number of users. pCloud says passwords and vault data were not compromised.
exec: pCloud says a contained attack on its password manager exposed user email addresses, according to Clubic; the company says vault data was not compromised.
action: pCloud warns users to watch for phishing and says it will never ask for a master password or recovery words, as Clubic reports.

validation.note: Only Clubic was read; pCloud's own statement (a Reddit post, per Clubic) was not read.

review.note: geo_basis wrongly said Clubic does not state Swiss base; Clubic says Swiss: fixed. Rest matches Clubic
